title: Reports: immutable graph snapshots and query options
objective: Create stable report snapshots with filtering, grouping, collapse, and evidence drill-down independent from renderers.
acceptance_criteria: Nodes and edges have stable IDs and snapshots are detached immutable values.
Package, type, member, layer, slice, artifact, and module collapse retain counts.
All renderers consume exactly the same queried snapshot.
non_goals: Do not weaken protected contracts, workflow configuration, or unrelated capabilities.
Do not load or execute target classes, builds, plugins, annotation processors, or code.
Do not copy implementation code from the upstream ArchUnit project.
Do not add dependencies or change Maven configuration.
